function.arguments: {"finding": "The `biomarker_final` values in `assay_batch == 'B'` are reported in µg/L, not ng/mL. The data dictionary explicitly states that 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL, so batch-B values must be divided by 10 to convert to ng/mL. This was implemented in the code by creating a new column `biomarker_final_ngml` and applying the conversion only to batch-B rows.", "implication": "Failing to convert batch-B values would result in a mean that is 10× too high. This correction is essential for the correct unit and valid estimation of the mean in ng/mL."}
function.name: note_finding
